text: Someone who claims to be your friend may not be telling the truth.
The sorrow when a close friend becomes an enemy is almost like mourning for a friend who has died.
Why do people's thoughts lead them to do wrong and spread deceit everywhere?
Some friends are happy for you when everything is fine, but when you have trouble they turn against you.
Another friend seems to help only for a free meal, but when you both go off to war, he gives you protection.[83]
Never forget your friends, and if you are successful, share your wealth with them.
When people claim to offer advice that is good for you, it may really be good for them.
Before you do what they say, see if they are looking out for themselves and putting you at risk
with their advice, while they can safely watch what happens to you.
If someone is jealous or suspicious of you, don't ask them for advice or tell them your plans.

If a man has two wives, don't ask one about the other. Take care who you ask for advice. A coward can't tell you how to fight in battle, and a store owner won't tell how much something is really worth. Can someone with a grudge show you how to be grateful, or someone mean tell you how to be kind? Don't bother asking a lazy person if work needs to be done. And don't ask someone who gets paid by the hour how long a job should take.
If you need advice, ask someone who obeys God's commands and thinks like you— someone who will be sad if you fail.
And trust your own judgment— you care more about yourself than anyone else does.
Thinking for yourself will often tell you more than if you had seven lookouts in a high tower.
But the most important thing is to pray that God Most High will show you what to do.
Before you begin a project, talk with others and get their advice.
Everything starts as an idea,[84]
whether it helps or harms, or brings life or death, and how people talk determines what they do.
Some people can give excellent advice to others but show no wisdom in their own lives.
And some who can speak well will be hated and starve,
because they speak without wisdom from the Lord, and they offend others.
If you see that certain people make wise choices themselves, you can depend on the advice they give to you.[85]
The wise teach their wisdom to God's people so their wisdom will live on.
The wise are admired and praised by everyone they meet.
Life is short for each of us, but Israel will last forever,
honoring the memory of those who shared their wisdom.
Take notice, students, what foods make you feel sick, and stay away from them.
After all, no one likes every kind of food.
Control any desire to overeat or to have lots of fancy food at every meal.
You will get sick if you eat too much.
Be careful! Many have died young from overeating.
